evidence.trustReason: Given: Scripted.start seeds a fresh repository, serves the real opencode command with a scripted model, and the test compares its committed tree against the real task-demo.sh seed minus unrelated examples. When: the client sends /task on example-cascade; the scripted model writes leaf files and trusts requested verifier IDs while the real proof gate still fails. Then: final status asserts T1.1 budget_exhausted and one attempt, only attempt-1 builder requests; T1.2 and parent T1 blocked with the exact cause; T1.3 and its obligation trusted. The held independent builder lets the test observe a running middle state after T1.1 dies, then the final state and ordered reason lines; run-end history follows T1.3 trust. Focused Bun test: 1 pass, 0 fail.
